name: [FAMILY TREE 👩‍👧‍👦] Humanlife 3: Civilization
desc:
Humanlife 3: Civilization 🌍 is a multiplayer civilization simulator where every life shapes history. 

------Private Servers---------------------------------------------------
Admin Console to play in creative mode and do events in private servers

------Description--------------------------------------------------------
Start in the Stone Age, give birth to 👶 real players, and pass on your legacy. 

Choose your path—🌾 farmer, 🛠 engineer, 🏹 warrior, or 💡 teacher—to help your people thrive. 

Work together to survive, grow, and advance through the ages, from stone tools to ⚙️ modern tech. 

Every generation leaves its mark—will yours lead your civilization to glory? 🏛✨
